subject.title: MissingAgentHarnessError race: non-atomic harness registry clear+restore during plugin cache cycle

question: Which harnesses, if any, should survive an activating empty plugin-scope reload in the loader and gateway startup paths?
rationale: Current code intentionally clears plugin-owned harnesses on activating reloads, while the open fix would restore all prior harnesses and could keep disabled or unscoped plugin runtimes callable.

options.title: Preserve Only Approved Always-On Harnesses
options.body: Define an ownership filter that preserves only maintainer-approved always-on/provider-owned harnesses while clearing disabled or unscoped plugin-owned harnesses.

options.title: Keep Strict Empty-Scope Clearing
options.body: Treat the shipped CLI-alias fixes as sufficient for the reported `claude-cli` symptom and leave plugin-owned harnesses cleared whenever the active registry is empty.

options.title: Adopt Restore-All Semantics
options.body: Allow every prior registered harness to survive empty-scope reloads, with explicit tests and documentation that this is the intended plugin lifecycle behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve Only Approved Always-On Harnesses
recommendation.body: Define an ownership filter that preserves only maintainer-approved always-on/provider-owned harnesses while clearing disabled or unscoped plugin-owned harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: The harness registry and selector originated in this area, and the decision affects the global runtime contract introduced there.
